data.name: San Diego: LGBTQ+ History Tour
data.headline: 1.5 Hours • All ages • LGBTQ+ History Tour • NEW!
data.description:
##Duration

1.5 Hours

##About

This walking tour of Hillcrest covers San Diego’s LGBTQ+ history with stories of some of its earliest gay bars, the hate crimes plaque, Harvey Milk Street, the Center, the Rainbow Flag and much more. The tour covers the people, places and events that made San Diego’s "gayborhood" the vibrant community it is today.

meeting_point.address: Urban MO's Mural, 3913 3rd Ave, San Diego, CA 92103

data.cancellation_notes: All tickets sales are final. Customers will receive a full refund in case of operator cancellation due to weather, minimum required reservations not obtained or other unforeseen circumstances.
data.booking_notes:
*Our tours START PROMPTLY AT THE DESIGNATED START TIME. Please allow plenty of time to find parking.* 

You will meet with your guide by Urban MO's Bar & Grill on the side with the Alex Julian Mural near the intersection of 3rd & University: 3913 3rd Ave, San Diego, CA 92103 
Good walking shoes, water, a hat and sunscreen are advised for the 1.1 mile-walk. 

**Parking:**
Please note parking in Hillcrest is limited and is often not free! Be sure to arrive early enough to give yourself plenty of time to find parking or you may want to use public transportation. 

There are paid parking lots at Rite-Aid, Poke Chop, Luna Grill, Peet's Coffee, Arrivederci, 5th & Evans and next to Jamba Juice. Non-metered street parking is available on 3rd or 1st Avenues. The tour ends at the Pride flagpole at Normal and University. Several bus lines stop within a few blocks so public transportation is an option.
